subject: general
question: As of December 2020, who is the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manoj Sinha** was appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir on August 7, 2020.
 
• He succeeded **Girish Chandra Murmu**, who resigned from the position.
 
• Prior to his appointment, Manoj Sinha served as the Minister of State for Railways and the Minister of State for Communications in the Government of India.
 
• As the Lieutenant Governor, he is responsible for the administration of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, which was reorganized from a state to a Union Territory on October 31, 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Lieutenant Governor is the representative of the President of India in the Union Territory.
 
• Jammu and Kashmir was granted special autonomy under Article 370 of the Indian Constitution, which was abrogated on August 5, 2019.
 
• The reorganization of Jammu and Kashmir resulted in the creation of two Union Territories: Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh.
 
• The Lieutenant Governor plays a crucial role in maintaining law and order and overseeing the implementation of central government policies in the Union Territory.
